scope.notes: Inventory in progress (27 rows). Covers Exalted: The Abyssals character-creation overview (Chapter Three), the universal Anima Effect available to every caste, all five Castes with their Anima Banners/Anima Effects/Caste Abilities/Associations, the Abyssal Curse, the Virtues of Death, the Resonance Trait (Abyssal Limit analog) including gain/loss/manifestation rules and the 1-10 Resonance Manipulation Effects table, the-title, Useful Crafts, the Cult-and-Abyssals exclusion sidebar, the six new deathknight-only Backgrounds (Abyssal Command, Liege, Necromancy, Spies, Underworld Manse, Whispers), and the altered Backgrounds (Artifact, Backing/Mentor, Familiar, Followers, Manse). Charm trees are not yet inventoried.

sources.role: Primary Abyssal rules, Charms, Backgrounds, and setting material

rulesNotes: Printed page numbers in this book run 1 less than the PDF page number supplied (PDF page = printed page + 1) for the copy used to build this inventory; both are recorded on every citation.
This PDF is image-based (no selectable text layer); all rows below were transcribed from rendered page images, per the 'OCR is an extraction aid, never verification by itself' rule.
Abyssals do not have a Limit Trait; Resonance (1-10) fills the equivalent role and is tracked/gained/lost differently. See the resonance-* inventory rows.
